answer: Sign in and open My Complaints or your citizen dashboard. Select your complaint to see its status, assignment and timeline. To check a specific complaint here, send its ID in complaint_id or write "status of complaint #123".

submitted: received; under_review: being assessed; assigned: routed to a department or officer; in_progress: work underway; verification_pending: staff submitted a resolution for the citizen to check; resolved: the citizen confirmed resolution; reopened: further work is needed.

answer: When staff submit a resolution, the complaint becomes verification_pending. The owning citizen checks the work and submits resolved=true to confirm, or resolved=false with optional feedback if it is still unresolved. Confirmation sets resolved and approved; rejection sets reopened and rejected.

answer: If your complaint is verification_pending and the issue is not fixed, reject the resolution with resolved=false and optional feedback; it will reopen. If you already confirmed it as resolved, authorized staff can reopen it. This chat provides guidance and does not change complaint status.

Admins route complaints to departments and active officers. Authorities work within their department or explicit assignments and can assign a compatible officer. Only admins transfer complaints between departments. Staff submit resolution evidence for citizen verification.
